abstract: A 27-year-old nulliparous woman presented with pain in the lower abdomen for six months. She was diagnosed to have bilateral dermoid cysts. Ovarian dermoid tumors can be bilateral in up to 15% of cases. After laparoscopy, we found that she had 7 dermoid cysts on the left side and 2 dermoid cysts on the right side, which is a rare occurrence. All the dermoid cysts were enucleated laparoscopically. The cysts were placed in an endobag and retrieved by morcellation. A one year follow up showed no evidence of recurrence or granulomatous peritonitis.
abstract_ja: 27歳の未経産女性が6か月間の下腹部痛を主訴に受診した。両側の類皮嚢腫と診断された。卵巣類皮腫瘍は症例の最大15%で両側性となりうる。腹腔鏡検査の結果、左側に7個、右側に2個の類皮嚢腫が認められ、これはまれな所見であった。すべての類皮嚢腫は腹腔鏡下に被膜を損なわずに摘出され、エンドバッグに収納し、モルセレーションにより回収された。1年間の経過観察では、再発や肉芽腫性腹膜炎の所見は認められなかった。
